name: CISA ScubaGear
what: A free assessment tool from CISA that compares a Microsoft 365 tenant with CISA's Secure Cloud Business Applications (SCuBA) baselines and writes an HTML report.
when: When you want an independent baseline check of Entra ID, Exchange Online, Defender, SharePoint, Teams and Power Platform settings, for example before an audit.
example: On a Windows machine, open Windows PowerShell 5.1 and run `Install-Module -Name ScubaGear`.
Install the required dependencies with `Install-ScubaDependencies`, then check the version with `Invoke-SCuBA -Version`.
Run the assessment for all products: `Invoke-SCuBA -ProductNames *` and sign in when prompted.
Open the generated report and fix the failed 'shall' items before the 'should' items.
pitfalls: The baselines reflect CISA's view for US federal agencies; decide which items fit your organization.
The account needs enough read permissions in each product, or checks show as errors.
Use a YAML config file to document accepted exceptions instead of ignoring failures.
